items.title: Vertentes (PE) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #001
items.en_title: Vertentes (PE) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #001
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Vertentes (PE) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 5,002.20; proposals close Nov 26, 10:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
